Scenario fixture: form-button-name-present

Each target has a stable id of the form fbnp_case_NN. RGAA 11.9.1 covers the buttons inside a <form> or an element with role="form".

A. Button in a form with no label (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: empty button in a form
02 — FAIL: input type="button" with no value in a role="form" element
03 — FAIL: button whose only content is a decorative image

B. Asked about (CANTTELL)

04 — CANTTELL: image button with no alt
05 — CANTTELL: empty button outside the form, joined by its form attribute

C. Button in a form with a label (PASS)

06 — PASS: button text
07 — PASS: button named by an svg title
08 — PASS: submit input with no value (browser label)

D. Outside a form (NOT APPLICABLE)

09 — NOT APPLICABLE: empty button outside any form
